notes.title: The Exlorer's Update is Here!

tags.feature: We’ve added new content – the CHARACTER GALLERY! If you ever wanted to take a closer look at the characters and their animations, now you can find collectibles in the game to unlock the 3D models.
There are new objects of great mystery and power scattered around the Lust from Beyond world for you to discover.
- Added the Credits button in the main menu;
- Added the last previewed hint in the inventory, goals, and player statistics panel (under the TAB key);
- After finding a collectible, a hint will appear stating how many are left to discover in the area at a given time;
- The leaves censoring the bosom of a statue in the dining room and the private parts of a statue in the attic corridor have been removed;

tags.bug: - In chapter I, when Theodore is in the ritual hall, the sound of the Vorh’n Essence preparation is not audible in the attic;
- In chapter III, the vanishing puddle near the phone with which the player calls Dr. Austerlitz has been fixed;
- In chapter III, the sound synchronization while tapping on the dead phone has been corrected;

tags.feature: - In chapter IV, a new event has been added… find out where!
- In chapter V the player can now enter the common room;

tags.bug: - The key to the common room doesn’t disappear from the inventory after entering the hotel for the first time;
- In chapter VIII, after loading in from the checkpoint, the previously solved puzzles remain solved;
- In chapter VIII, the player cannot interrupt a conversation that we won’t spoil by opening the inventory;
- In chapter VII, the segments of cabinets and books which would pass through other models have been fixed;
- In chapter XI, quickly picking up Tarot cards in Mabel’s room doesn’t cause them to be put down incorrectly;
- In chapter X, after being caught in the iron maiden the player doesn’t die if their number of lives is higher than the default;
- In chapter X, the player cannot overfill their inventory;
- In chapter XI, after collecting certain three items and restarting the chapter, Tim doesn’t pretend to not see the player;
- In chapter XI, the sound synchronization has been corrected in the scene with Dr. Austerlitz;

tags.feature: - In chapter XIV, the sounds during the sex scene with a certain fan-favourite character have been enhanced;

tags.bug: - In chapter XIV, the one tentacle which has been visibly lighter than the rest has been fixed;
- In chapter XIV, while opening a gate, its elements don’t pass through the floor;
- In chapter XV, the Changed don’t fall through the floor after dying;

tags.feature: - The missing dialogues of the conversation with Amanda in French and Korean have been added;
- The chicken-like Enthralled has been equipped with new sounds;
- In the chapters taking place in Lusst’ghaa, the environment has been enhanced;

tags.bug: - Ground collisions in Lusst'ghaa were improved by eliminating places where the player’s character jumped unnecessarily;

tags.feature: - Added the option to skip the cutscenes: in chapter II – the sex scene with [SPOILER AVERTED], in chapter XIV – the sex scene with [WE WON’T TELL YOU!], and in chapter XIV – the sex scene with [NOPE];

tags.bug: - In all chapters, the collisions, switching lights, disappearing models, and holes in the environment have been fixed;

tags.feature: - More Kickstarter backers have been added to the game credits;

tags.balance_change: - In the hotel’s Chamber of Pleasure the radio sound range has been increased;

tags.feature: - When starting a New Game, the previously unlocked Chambers of Pleasure stay unlocked.

notes.title: Sensual Update Is Here!
notes.content:
Hi there, Cultists!

We’re happy to share the news about the new update that’s just landed on Steam. We’ve fixed some minor issues and added very juicy content. Enjoy!

[previewyoutube=5DPqgu0ChFE;full][/previewyoutube]


[h3]Changes[/h3]
[b]WARNING: mild spoilers ahead. We did our best to avoid them.[/b]

ADDITIONAL CONTENT - CHAMBERS OF PLEASURE
[list]
[*]Additional content has been added to the main menu, which contains the entrance to the four Chambers of Pleasure.
[/list]

OPTIONAL SEX WITH AMANDA AND/OR MABEL
[list]
[*] In chapter XIV optional sex with Mabel has been added if… try to figure it out; get to know each other better  ;)
[*] In chapter XIV added optional sex with Amanda
[/list]

SOME OTHER CHANGES
[list]
[*] In Chapter III, while sleeping in a hotel, a sound of tugging on a door closed behind the player character has been added.
[*] The policewoman has received a new stop shield in chapter III. 
[*] In Chapter III, a handle was added to hold a mirror in a car.
[*] in chapter IV, in the hotel, a hole has been added in the wall of room 206, through which you can see what is going on in room 205
[*] In chapter IV, Bobby's voice can be heard in the hotel when the cultist is torturing him
[*] In chapter VI, the cultist holding the rope on the stage has his ear covered
[*] In Chapter IV, the wall near the staircase in the hotel has been repaired.
[*] in chapter VII, a bug with restarting the dialogue with Amanda after loading the first checkpoint of the level has been fixed
[*] Dialog with the Shackley brothers, when they jump on us with the mask in chapter VII, is interrupted when we move away from them
[*] Added a rope binding the hands of a dead person in chapters X and XI (the body lying next to the iron maiden)
[*] In chapter XI the bloodied cultist doesn't stop running after the player and doesn't stop after the first approach of the player
[*] In chapter XII, the mask on the table in the dining room during the orgy has the correct axis of rotation
[*] In Chapter XII, Victor doesn't get dressed after interactive sex
[*] The Changed in Chapter XIV have been given overlays to make them look different
[*] In chapter X SFX has been added when a cultist comes out of the first door with the bone symbol
[*] In chapter XI new vocalizations have been added for one of the most important enemies in the game
[*] In chapter XI dialog of doctor with... has been extended
[*] Added smooth muting of orgy sounds in chapter XII when reloading a level or going to main menu of the game
[*] Some sound changes with more... hardcore scenes with Amanda in chapter XV
[*] Even sexier sounds for the monster in chapter XV
[*] Corrected censorship on Transformed during monster orgy in epilogues
[*] Corrected lights in the mansion and Lusst'ghaa, which were switching depending on the position of the player character
[*] Eliminated all detected spots where the player character was blocked.
[*] Victor's masturbator was renamed from "fleshlight" to "Love Hole".
[*] Added two new subtitles on building walls in Bleakmoor, sent by Kickstarter backers
[*] Names of two more Kickstarter backers were added to the book in the basement of the mansion
[*] New mask of the supporter in the basement of the mansion has been distributed
[*] Added new assets in the mansion - Sabinian's wine and Amanda's poster
[*] One submissive received a new set of sounds and another one received sound refinements
[*] Dialogues and object descriptions in French, Japanese and Korean have been corrected
[*] The translation of "Police Woman" changed to "Police Officer".
[*] Added more Kickstarter backers to the end credits
[/list]
And more ;)

Check out the update and tell us how you like it.

notes.title: Mini-update 1.0.2! See what’s better
notes.content:
Hey Cultists! There’s a mini-update waiting for you in Lust from Beyond. Check out why it makes the game better.

[list]
[*] We added footsteps sound on the V’akl in Lusst’ghaa.
[*] We removed the protruding wall in the mansion’s bathroom.
[*] We improved the occlusion in the antique shop’s kitchen in Chapter II.
[*] Floor collisions in Lusst’ghaa, in chapters I, II, III and VI, now work better.
[*] Now there are trees behind the wind of the antique shop in Chapter II.
[*] In Chapter VII, Donald now reacts to Victor if he stares at the twins in the toilet.
[*] We added footstep sounds behind the final gate in Chapter XI.
[*] Fixed: In Chapter XIV, when you choose to increase your sanity at the altar at zero sanity, the Insanity Clusters no longer disappear.
[*] In Chapter XI, the sound of the cultist doing number two is now louder.
[*] Fix: Now you can aim at that person you fight in Chapter XV before the first fight starts.
[*] If you shoot at the Child of [WE WON’T SPOIL IT] in Chapter XV, it now jumps up in the air.
[*] We reinstated the sounds during the interaction with one of the monsters in Epilogue, and added some new ones.
[/list]
Look forward to the next update, as it is shaping up very juicily. Here’s a sneak peek of what you can expect.

[previewyoutube=Pf5suM562Ko;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: New Patch Is Here!
notes.content:
Check out what’s new below. Thanks for all your feedback!

[b]Oh, and WARNING: mild spoilers ahead. We did our best to avoid them.[/b]

[h2][b]NEW INSANITY SYSTEM[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Controls DO NOT get reverted when your sanity drops to zero.
[*] Huh? What was that?! Low sanity makes you hear creeeepy noises.
[*] Is this real life? Or is this a fantasy? Zero sanity makes you see the Changed spectres even in the real world!
[*] Zero sanity spawns Insanity Clusters. Better avoid looking at them, or you could do something you’d regret.
[/list]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/dQPwOAwhRZOFHyyYhT/giphy.gif[/img]

[h2][b]OTHER CHANGES[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fix: changing key bindings now unbinds previously used keys.
[*] Fix: equipment, end slates and character stats now display correctly on widescreen monitors.
[*] Fix: stuck points don’t make you stuck anymore.
[*] Fix: you can’t get two ritual knives anymore. Sorry!
[*]Fix: jumping on concrete floor barefoot not makes a proper *plaf* noise. We also fixed it for jumping on steel bars.
[*] Music mix was improved.
[*] Corrupted Enthralled now sport a brand new skin.
[*] Victor’s mutations now have new textures.
[*] AI now acts smarter in the hotel, Bleakmoor, on the roofs, in the theatre, and in the theatre underground.
[*] Portal tentacles are now much more wiggly-waggly.
[*] Unmasked Amanda’s hair now looks better.
[*] Payphone textures in Bleakmoor and the hotel have been improved.
[*] There’s a new drawing in the drawer in the mansion attic.
[*] Collision problems, disappearing and overlapping objects are no more.
[*] Jonathan’s eyes are now more organic.
[*] The Chamber of Change textures are now prettier.
[*] Improved and added a bunch of sound effects.
[*] Best Streamer Parrot will brighten your day in the antique shop.
[*] Chapter One Amanda’s scar is now more... scarry.
[*] New textures on bathroom models in Chapter Two.
[*] Added bloodstains on the cross in the theater.
[*] Loading a save in Chapter Five no longer spawns the enemies from the previous run.
[*] You can hear Vorh’ns behind the wall in Chapter Six.
[*] What’s this? Bandages on the scene in the theatre, in Chapter Six?
[*] Fix: the Shackleys’ body in Chapter Seven now displays properly.
[*] Bobby’s medicine from Chapter Seven now has a brand new texture.
[*] Fix: Chapter Eight now doesn’t have strange time travel issues with recurring events from previous playthroughs.
[*] Fix: the Russian version now has the translated version of the note in the Shackley twins’ room in Chapter Nine.
[*] Fix: translation fix for the Amanda dialogue in Chapter Nine.
[*] Fix: Amanda’s face doesn’t act weird anymore in Chapter Nine.
[*] Added sound for Shackley twins reaching for the key in Chapter Nine.
[*] Added a chess trophy in the Hall of Whispers.
[*] Added guts on the table as well as boards in the theatre underground.
[*] Fixed the model of the thing that Danny takes care of in Chapter Ten.
[*] Fix: Danny climbing the table in Chapter Ten.
[*] Removed the sanity and life depletion at the end of Chapter Ten. 
[*] Added Tim’s special something for the moment when he’s not present in the cell in Chapter Ten.
[*] We added a new VO for when the surprise cultist from Chapter Ten is taking damage and dying.
[*] New texture for the blood-covered cultist in Chapter Eleven.
[*] Victor now has a new voice-over for when he does what he does with Rhea in Chapter Eleven.
[*] Fix: when Tim is kneeling in Chapter Eleven, he’s no longer spinning, even if this is a good trick.
[*] Fix: Austerlitz’s hat in Chapter Eleven doesn’t disappear anymore.
[*] Fix: fixed Austerlitz’s speech after Big Tim’s you-know-what after you load a checkpoint.
[*] Added a healing platform in Lusst’ghaa in Chapter Eleven.
[*] Fix: the possibility to leave the dining room naked in Chapter Twelve.
[*] Removed the renewal of sanity and health before you speak with a certain character in Lusst’ghaa in Chapter Thirteen.
[*] Added new Lusst’ghaa environmental sounds in Chapter Fourteen.
[*] You are now able to pick up a medkit before reaching the mission goal in Chapter Fourteen.
[*] Added blood to the dress of certain someone when he or she is wounded, and reduced the amount of blood on the bandage.
[*] Added Lusst’ghaa environmental sounds before you start Chapter Fifteen.
[*] Added sounds to the animation of Victor attacking a certain person after exiting the portal.
[*] Added body collision to a certain person in Chapter Fifteen.
[*] Added blood in the bathtub with a dead cultist in Chapter Fifteen.
[*] In Chapter Fifteen, additional sounds during the death scene of… we won’t tell you who dies, obviously!
[*] Added portal opening sounds for when _someone_ opens it in Chapter Fifteen.
[*] Added a fittingly discouraging sound of a broken healing point in Chapter Fifteen.
[*] Fixed the Japanese translation of one of the dialogues in Chapter Fifteen.
[*] Fix: the teeth of the dead body from the epilogue don’t hover in the air anymore, for better or worse.
[/list]

Thank you for all reports, feedback, and suggestions that you keep sending to us from the premiere time! Thanks to it, we were able to prepare some improvements, and we are working on many more to come. Today we released a new version of Lust from Beyond. Here is the changelog:

We can't wait to get your feedback, so let us know how the game works for you now.

[b]Have fun,[/b]
[i]WIllard Yelverton[/i]

[b]Dear Cultists! [/b]
[b]We wanted to publish "Lust from Beyond: Prologue" on Halloween for everyone for free[/b], but we have some problem with publishing it on Steam (because we send it to Steam too late). So we will publish the demo probably after the Halloween.
BUT we really want you to play it as soon as possible, so.... Look around. ;)

Reminder: [b]LUST FROM BEYOND: PROLOGUE[/b] is still Kickstarter demo with some changes like:
- Steam achievements 
- new notes, that teases plots from the full version of Lust from Beyond
- possibility to open the door under the stairs
- option improvements (mouse sensivity etc)
- fixing some bugs, glitches etc.
- new cutscene in the end
